result.title: Binary Sparse Codes: Where are we on Energy Efficient Representations?
result.summary: Biological neural systems achieve impressive computational capabilities under tight metabolic constraints, relying on sparse cortical representations that minimise total neural activity. This combination of efficiency and representational power has motivated growing interest in sparse coding as a computational strategy for artificial systems. Artificial models designed to produce binary sparse codes span three broad paradigms, theoretical methods grounded in efficient coding, deep learning methods trained via backpropagation, and biologically plausible methods that learn through local Hebbian rules, each yielding codes whose quality depends not only on achieving low activation density but also on preserving the informational structure of the input. The latter property, however, lacks an agreed-upon quantitative definition, leaving the field without a principled basis for comparing methods. We propose a set of metrics that formalise information preservation as similarity preservation, measuring how faithfully a binary sparse code reproduces the relational geometry of the input space, and apply this framework to compare four representative methods under matched conditions. The results reveal a consistent trade-off in which models that achieve high information preservation do so at the cost of sparsity, while models approaching the uniformity of an optimal random sparse code tend to sacrifice it. Competitive Sparse Codes, a biologically plausible approach, is the only architecture to occupy a region of near-maximal sparsity while retaining meaningful information preservation. These findings frame the simultaneous satisfaction of both factors as an open challenge for the field and provide a reusable evaluation framework for measuring progress toward it.

AI.brief_summary: 论文梳理产生二值稀疏编码的三类范式（高效编码理论、反向传播训练、局部 Hebbian 生物可行学习），提出以「相似性保持」定量刻画信息保持的度量，并在匹配条件下比较四种代表性方法，揭示稀疏性与信息保持之间的权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其相似性保持度量可能可供核查，用于量化 LVR 内部状态是否保留输入的关系几何，以及稀疏压缩与视觉细节信息坍缩之间的取舍；但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
